candidate_reports.remark: Rainfall over the past hour. Light rain falling at time of report.
Route 40 under closed and under water between I-80 and Route 6. Also train crossing is under water.
Water over the road closing this section.
0.5 inches of rainfall from 1300-1315 local time.
Report via Facebook: Interstate 80 is flooded near Route 40 exit. Rerouting traffic. On Route 40 just south of interstate 80 the road is closed due to flooding.
Continued Extreme rain as reported my Tempest PWS. Visibility under 1/4 mile measured to known landmark. Water runoff pending on roads. Total rain above measured from 0830 to1330 local.
Significant amount of water_ 6 or more inches deep_ flowing over County Highway 19 with field debris stuck in the road. Video from social media.
Emergency Manager reports Douglas Creek and Edwards River out of banks and flooding near Ulah.
County Highway 14 closed due to water over the road.
Observed 4.02 inches of rainfall with rain gauge on the southwest side of Cambridge_ IL.
Total through 16:30 local. Report via Facebook.
Gauge was blocked during initial rainfall (est. 0.5inches). Measured an additional 0.3 inches after gauge was unblocked.
Overnight rainfall total. Some ponding of water in the yard.
Total since midnight. Multiple rounds with rates over 1 in/hr.
Still raining at time of report.
Rainfall total from just today. Water standing in fields.
Total since 8am. 0.5 inches in the last 20 minutes.
Rain total since Monday morning. 2.9 inches total since Sunday morning.
